transcript: Did you know that if you press the top of your nose firmly and at the same time press the spot right under your nose, your blocked nose can start to open up in under a minute? In the old teachings, the body is not random. Every point has a pathway. These two small places sit near important nerve channels connected to your nasal passages. When you apply calm, steady pressure, you gently signal the body to relax the tension inside the sinuses. As the pressure holds, circulation slightly shifts. The swollen feeling may soften. The breath begins to move again, not by force, but by balance returning. No pills, no sprays, just awareness and your own hands. An old monk once told me, when breath is blocked, the mind becomes restless. When breath flows, the spirit settles. Hold for 60 seconds. Breathe slowly. Let the body respond. Comment yes if this helped you. And follow for more ancient wisdom made simple.
